title: Paris: Louvre to Montmartre
summary: Six nights built around the city's rhythm rather than a checklist — a proper half-day inside the Louvre, a Versailles day trip, and evenings that end on the Seine or the steps of Montmartre.
highlights: The Louvre, given a proper half-day rather than a rush
Sunset from the steps of Sacré-Cœur
A slow river cruise past Notre-Dame

itinerary.title: Arrive in Paris
itinerary.description: Settle into a Left Bank hotel, then an easy first evening walking the Seine as the bridges light up.

itinerary.title: The Louvre
itinerary.description: A guided morning through the essentials, then the afternoon left open to wander the wings that caught your eye.

itinerary.title: Notre-Dame & the Marais
itinerary.description: A slow river cruise past the restored cathedral, then a pastry-shop crawl through the Marais's old streets.

itinerary.title: Montmartre
itinerary.description: The funicular up to Sacré-Cœur, an afternoon among the artists at Place du Tertre, and sunset from the basilica steps.

itinerary.title: Versailles
itinerary.description: A full day trip to the palace and gardens, timed to beat the tour-bus crowds through the Hall of Mirrors.

itinerary.title: The Eiffel Tower & farewell dinner
itinerary.description: A morning visit up the tower, then a dinner cruise on the Seine as it lights up for the night.

itinerary.title: Depart Paris
itinerary.description: A final café breakfast before your transfer to the airport.

included: 6 nights in a Left Bank boutique hotel
Skip-the-line Louvre entry with a guide
Versailles day trip with a guide
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
